name: Isha Awak
summary: Along the Merchant Coast, Mahren Skyseer sends you hunting in the Great Sea. Slay Isha Awak, the Deep Doom, and bring back its heart for a rite of spirit and respect.

sections.title: The Deep Doom
sections.body: South of Ratchet, Isha Awak prowls beneath the waves. The immense sea creature is known as the Deep Doom and holds the coastal waters by force. Human forces camped along the shore fear those waters. They have lost many scouts and soldiers to the predator.

sections.title: A Hunt of Spirit
sections.body: Mahren Skyseer reveres the leviathan, while the humans fear it. To the tauren mystic, Isha Awak is no curse or mere pest. It is a worthy foe whose might tests a hunter's resolve. Slaying the beast brings spiritual communion. Its heart holds the beast's essence, and claiming it lets the hunter carry that untamed spirit forward.

faq.answer: Known as the Deep Doom, Isha Awak prowls the waters off the eastern Barrens, south of Ratchet. The powerful sea beast rules those coastal waters and preys on nearby human sailors and soldiers.

faq.q: Why does Mahren Skyseer want Isha Awak slain?
faq.answer: Mahren Skyseer sees Isha Awak as a worthy and honorable opponent, and a spiritual challenge. She believes overcoming the beast lets a hunter absorb its strength and commune with its wild spirit.

faq.q: Where can Isha Awak be found?
faq.answer: Isha Awak swims in the Great Sea along the Merchant Coast in the eastern Barrens. It is south of Ratchet and near the human-inhabited shore.

faq.q: What happens when you bring back the heart?
faq.answer: Mahren Skyseer believes the creature's essence and fate rest in its heart. Bringing it to her binds you in spirit to the fallen leviathan, so you carry a portion of Isha Awak's strength and predatory sight.

faq.q: Who are the humans mentioned by Mahren?
faq.answer: Mahren speaks of the Theramore and Kul Tiras forces along the Barrens coast, especially around Northwatch Hold and nearby outposts. They have lost many sailors and shore-dwellers to the beast's jaws.

faq.q: Is Isha Awak considered an elemental or a natural animal?
faq.answer: Isha Awak is a natural aquatic beast of the Great Sea, though exceptionally large and powerful. Local tauren revere its primal spirit and skill as a hunter.

angles.text: As a tauren, you follow a tradition that respects prey rather than despising it. Taking a life can bring communion with the creature's spirit.
As a hunter, you track a legendary aquatic beast into the Great Sea. There, your patience, cunning, and marksmanship face a test in its own territory.
As a member of the Horde, you face the Deep Doom along the Merchant Coast. It has terrorized local Alliance outposts.
